market.question: Will the highest temperature in Paris be 13°C on May 6?

assessment.reasoning: Paris forecast for May 6 shows high ~24°C (per Sortiraparis weekly forecast). The 13°C bucket is 11°C below forecast — extremely unlikely. Even with cloud cover suppressing temps a few degrees, won't approach 13°C.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major synoptic shift not in current forecasts
